records.utterance: I logged every resource and decision from these five days. I'm going to write it up as a proper report when we get back. On the last page I left myself a question I haven't answered yet — if you had to do it over, what would you change?
records.response_truth:
Hmm.

I'd probably talk more. Like, actually say things when I was thinking them instead of sitting on it until it became a problem. The crackers thing, the notebook thing, DaVinci's reef plan... Also I'd have asked Michelangelo about his family's flight path thing way earlier. Like on day one. "Does anyone know we were on this plane, does anyone know the route" - that's just... that should've been one of the first questions. I don't know. I think I was trying not to be the person who makes everything harder by saying uncomfortable things out loud. And then I ended up being that person anyway, just later, when everyone was already more tired and more scared. Probably would've been easier earlier.

records.utterance: First thing when I get back — I'm going to compile all the resource data from these five days into a report.
